summary: mpmath.pslq at dps=2160 reported a candidate integer relation at iteration K=8783, contradicting the historical m32a cascade null at K=29363. Arb-rigorous verification of the candidate against the M1 certified balls REJECTED it as spurious (sum |sum_i m_i x_i| = 1.745e-285 versus propagated uncertainty 4.67e-8642). Diagnosed: m32a used mpmath.khinchin directly; this M2 run uses M1 Arb ball midpoints. The tiny midpoint difference altered the PSLQ trajectory enough to drive mpmath into a precision-limited false termination at dps=2160. RESOLUTION: re-run mpmath at higher dps so it does not terminate spuriously.

evidence.verdict: candidate is spurious; not a true integer relation among certified basis

contrast_with_m32a_cascade_2026_05_16.consequence: different K_0 midpoint values cause PSLQ to find spurious relation at dps=2160 in the M1-certified midpoint case but not in the mpmath.khinchin case

next_action: Re-run mpmath.pslq at dps=4320 (and escalate to dps=8640 if needed) using M1 Arb ball midpoints. The expected outcome is termination via norm_bound > maxcoeff at some K_true, with K_true >> 8783; this K_true is what feeds the certified FBA Corollary 2 bound.
